description: Read a single file from a repository at a given ref (branch / tag / commit). Private repos are readable when the authenticated caller has access. Returns the text content (binary files rejected).

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

ref.description: Branch / tag / commit. Defaults to the repository's actual default branch (which may not be 'main' — e.g. 'Main').

name: gluecron_repo_read_file
